instructions:
The repository's suites under tests/ are the rig for this product: they drive
the real firstmate scripts against real worktrees and real processes, with
PATH-shimmed terminal and harness binaries. bin/fm-test-run.sh is the
authority on which suites exist; run one with
`FM_LIVE=0 bin/fm-test-run.sh tests/<subject>.test.sh` - FM_LIVE=0 makes the
live-gated suites self-skip, since those launch real harnesses and real
terminal servers on this machine. Drive the change through the suites for the
area it touches - prove the change works, and prove the regression fails
without it.
Out of scope here: standing up rigs of your own - live tmux servers, dirty
worktrees, fake agent binaries, or reusable lab factories - beyond what the
suites under tests/ already set up.
